purpose.target_triangles: One reduced runtime surface retains the approved silhouette and physically recessed lifelines; automated collapse is not hand retopology.
purpose.weight_smoothing_passes: Blend joint boundaries over connected topology, keeping the skull and soles rigid.
purpose.fps: Bake fitted joint targets at 40 samples per second for in-place interpolation.
purpose.walk_stance_fraction: Each foot remains planted for 60 percent of a cycle, with a short double-support interval.
purpose.walk_foot_travel_units: The backward foot travel during support, in the original two-unit studio scale.
purpose.walk_cycle_travel_units: Foot travel divided by stance fraction; coordinator advances walk phase by actual actor travel divided by this value times uniform scale.
purpose.walk_foot_lift_units: Toe clearance during the forward swing; no runtime terrain IK is implied.
purpose.stance_sink_units: Small supported crouch gives long legs room for the stride without stretching bones.
purpose.breath_units: Subtle idle rise while both feet retain their ground targets.
purpose.call_neck_radians: Lift the supported throat for the native recruitment gesture.
purpose.call_head_radians: Raise the beak during calling, preserving ordinary eyes and attached crown.
purpose.call_jaw_radians: Open the fitted lower beak about its root; visual motion only.
purpose.call_throat_expansion: Small local widening of the resonator leaves its cavities open.
purpose.windup_neck_radians: Draw the head back during the existing half-second melee tell.
purpose.peck_neck_radians: A modest forward peck represents the existing weak close attack.
purpose.suggested_scale: Uniform 0.8 gives a roughly 1.6 metre tall crane; retain the existing capsule and actor family/elite scale separately.
